title: Dose-dependent Effect of Rosuvastatin on Long-term Clinical Outcomes After PCI

sections.abstract: This study is a prospective, randomized, open-label, single-center trial designed to compare the 30 month-safety and efficacy between low-dose (5mg/dL) and high-dose (20mg/dL) rosuvastatin treatment for patients with coronary artery disease after percutaneous coronary intervention with the newer drug-eluting stent.
